gambia.title: Flag of the Republic of The Gambia

colors.note: Top band evoking the sun and the savannas.
Narrow stripes bordering the blue, symbolising peace and unity.
Central band representing the Gambia River that defines the country.
Bottom band standing for agriculture and the land.

desc:
- Three horizontal bands of red, blue and green, separated by narrow white fimbriations
- The central blue band depicts the Gambia River around which the country is shaped
- Adopted on 18 February 1965 when the country became independent from the United Kingdom
trivia:
- Remained in use unchanged during the 1982-1989 Senegambia Confederation with Senegal
- The Gambia River, symbolised by the blue band, runs the entire length of the country
- Designed by accountant Louis Thomasi, chosen without an open public competition
